","icon":"","option":"【开场白】"},"9gbw054tlbuT1759654540537":{"dialogue":"

","icon":"","option":"【你看上去也不像赚钱了…】"},"nqb471m7nmnT1710863941173":{"dialogue":"

","icon":"","option":"【认购券是什么？】"},"y8sro1bqaqqT1759654540930":{"dialogue":"

","icon":"","option":"【还是算了吧。】"},"z2tn3pzsbujT1710863943430":{"dialogue":"
